base_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent panoramic footer illustration for HAMRAH, a Persian forex-education company whose actual product is planned practice, a journal comparing plan with execution, and human coach feedback. NEW CREATIVE DIRECTION: 'the decision review workspace'. Show a coherent, believable PREMIUM PRODUCT ARTIFACT rather than a borrowed luxury metaphor. Three large floating dark-emerald GLASS WORKSPACE PANELS arranged across one shallow horizontal arc, in right-to-left sequence: RIGHT panel is a disciplined pre-decision plan with exactly three clearly shaped square checklist marks, two softly lit and one empty, and a clean horizontal risk-limit bracket; CENTER panel is an execution record, with a planned straight dotted lime route and one small warm-neutral action marker visibly offset from that route, a very short dashed connector makes the gap legible, framed as a recorded difference not a profitable price move; LEFT panel is a human feedback annotation represented by a single sculptural speech-comment frame attached to the execution record and one highlighted next-practice square. One restrained thin lime line connects the three panels and gently returns toward the plan, expressing learning through review. Panels feel related parts of a real decision-journal/coaching workspace, not unrelated floating icons. No invented metrics or financial outcomes. Visual treatment: refined photorealistic high-end 3D product rendering, smoked deep-green architectural glass #172b2b, satin graphite edge hardware, restrained lime #d2f36b edge light, soft ivory reflections, precision fine contour lines; sufficient contrast against a dark-green #14231f website. Panoramic wide landscape canvas around 3:1, low horizontal composition, three clear focal groups of comparable size filling central 85% width, generous transparent margins; shallow three-quarter perspective, no tall towers, all three panels fully visible and uncropped. NO book, no notebook object, no paper pages, no marble, no statues, no hands, no people, no mystical orb, no coins, no currency signs, no candlestick chart, no upward growth arrow, no trophies, no numbers, no logos, no words or tiny fake writing, no watermark. Checklist marks and short line strokes are geometric only. Genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background with no floor, solid backdrop, vignette rectangle or drawn checkerboard. Deliver the isolated product sculpture only, not a full webpage mockup.
